name: Femboy Fury
storyline:
Once a year on New Years Eve, Fzzy Bzzy hosts a deadly tournament in which drivers compete to get their deepest wish granted! Can you make it thru all 8 levels and claim your character's wish?

Choose between 10 deadly femboys competing in a high-octane demolition derby! Find dastardly devastating weapon from bloody ricochets to gasoline-bombs! Compete through 8 different levels from a small drive-in theater, through a friendly neighborhood, to even the depths of hell!

Gameplay is a simple yet fun arcade like drive-and-shoot! Franticly search for weapon pick-ups as you dodge enemies chasing you every chance they get! Get pursued through a semi-destructible environment as you slaughter the other 9 contestants who will stop at nothing you have their dreams granted!
summary: Femboy Fury is a demolition derby of high-octane proportions! Choose between 10 femboy characters and compete in an arcade like drive-and-shoot in semi-destructible environments! Franticly search for weapon pick-ups as you dodge enemies chasing you! Be the last femboy driving in 8 levels!
